subject: Debrief: Senior Inference Engineer (Jordan Lee) — scorecards + hiring decision
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rebecca Gomez <rebecca@growthhire.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Debrief: Senior Inference Engineer (Jordan Lee) — scorecards + hiring decision

Team —

Thanks for interviewing Jordan today. Quick ask: please upload your filled scorecard (see template attached) and reply with a 1–2 sentence recommendation (hire / no-hire / hire-with-conditions) by 6pm PT today. We want to get a consensus ahead of the hiring committee tomorrow morning. If you have a strong objection, flag it in your note and call it out — I will escalate to the bar-raiser if needed.

Key context:
- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (backend, quantization & serving)
- On-site/loop conducted: System design (Dev), Inference runtime deep-dive (Ava), Culture & leadership (Evelyn), Performance troubleshooting (Rishi)

Attachments: consolidated_scorecard_template.xlsx (Excel) — please use the overall rubric and include a 1–5 score for Technical Depth, System Design, Product Judgment, Communication, and Culture fit.

Thanks — aiming to close this quickly.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 16:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Inference Engineer (Jordan Lee) — scorecards + hiring decision

Laura / team —

Attached my scorecard: JordanLee_Scorecard_ava.pdf. TL;DR: lean hire. Strong on latency optimization, register-level thinking about KV cache and batching. Gave 5/5 for technical depth and 4/5 for system design. Minor concerns: limited hands-on experience with quantized kernels at 4-bit — he understands the theory but hasn't shipped production 4-bit quantization flows.

Notes:
- Candidate explained a concrete plan for cache invalidation and prefix caching strategies that maps well to our serving runtime.
- Good ownership examples from previous startup (reduced p99 by 30% through batching and dynamic prefetch).
- Communication was crisp; could use a bit more depth on memory layout tradeoffs for specific GPUs.

Recommendation: hire-with-conditions — pair program for 1 month with a senior on kernel/quantization work and a small ramp plan.

Attachments: JordanLee_Scorecard_ava.pdf (PDF)

Ava
Senior Software Engineer, Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Inference Engineer (Jordan Lee) — scorecards + hiring decision

Laura —

Scorecard attached: JordanLee_Scorecard_dev.pdf. I focused on system design and the coding exercise. My scores: Technical Depth 4/5, System Design 4/5, Communication 4/5. Overall: slight lean hire.

Detailed notes:
- Implemented a reasonably clean streaming decoder in the coding exercise. Code had a small bug in KV eviction which he caught quickly after prompt; showed good debugging approach.
- System design: proposed sharding by request fingerprint + a fallback routing policy; recognized tradeoffs around cross-node KV consistency. Would have liked more detail on cross-GPU synchronization under long-context use cases (he deferred to "we'd use eventual consistency and accept small staleness").
- Latency awareness: good — explicitly reasoned about microbatched pipelines and per-token tail latency.

Concerns: lacks examples of shipping low-level CUDA kernels. If you need someone to implement kernel-level optimizations immediately, this candidate will be ramping. For infra/serving work higher up the stack, strong fit.

Attachments: JordanLee_Scorecard_dev.pdf (PDF), code-sandbox link: https://codesandbox.redwood.ai/jordan-lee-session

—Dev
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 17:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Inference Engineer (Jordan Lee) — scorecards + hiring decision

Quick note — attached my scorecard (JordanLee_Scorecard_rishi.pdf).

Scores: Tech Depth 3/5, Performance Troubleshooting 5/5, Product Judgment 3/5.

Key point: Jordan was very effective at triaging a real-world perf regression in the mock exercise (identified batching misconfiguration + long-tail tokenization cost). He is excellent at observability-driven debugging which we need. My hesitation is around long-term ownership of quantization roadmap (3/5).

Recommendation: hire, but title calibration to Senior (not Staff) and include a 6-month tech ramp with clear quantization deliverables.

—Rishi
Staff SWE, Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 18:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Inference Engineer (Jordan Lee) — scorecards + hiring decision

Laura & team —

Attached: JordanLee_Scorecard_evelyn.pdf. Short version: do not hire. Culture/leadership concerns.

Notes:
- During the leadership portion, Jordan gave several examples that suggested limited proactive cross-team communication (prefers to work independently rather than drive cross-functional initiatives). We value strong partner management here.
- Was evasive when I asked about a past post-mortem where their team had an outage; didn't name stakeholders or concrete follow-up actions.

If we hire, I would want a probationary plan with clear communication outcomes or a hiring bar-raiser review. My recommendation: no-hire unless candidate accepts explicit development plan and we reduce initial scope.

Evelyn
Engineering Manager, Platform & People
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rebecca Gomez <rebecca@growthhire.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 18:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Debrief: Senior Inference Engineer (Jordan Lee) — scorecards + hiring decision

Thanks all for fast turnarounds and detailed notes — appreciate it. I consolidated your attached scorecards into the spreadsheet (consolidated_scorecard_20260308.xlsx) and ran a quick average:

Aggregate (avg out of 5):
- Technical Depth: 4.0
- System Design: 4.25
- Communication: 3.75
- Culture/Leadership: 3.0
- Overall: 3.75

Summary: clear engineering strength in performance troubleshooting and inference-serving patterns. Mixed signals on deep quant-kernel implementation experience and cross-team leadership. Team consensus: lean hire with conditions (per Ava & Dev & Rishi) vs Evelyn's no-hire. Because this is a split decision and Evelyn raised people/leadership concerns, I want one short sync before we escalate to the hiring committee.

Next steps I propose:
1) 15-min sync (this afternoon) to see if Eve's concerns are disqualifying or addressable with a probation plan. If we can't converge, I will take this thread + consolidated scorecard to the hiring committee tomorrow.
2) If we move forward with hire: offer level Senior, 6-month ramp plan (quant deliverables), and a 3-month checkpoint with a people manager.

Please reply with availability in the next 60 minutes, or state your veto if you want to stop the process. Rebecca, please stand by — we may ask for an offer hold or next steps.

Attachments: consolidated_scorecard_20260308.xlsx (Excel), summary-notes.txt (plain text)

Laura
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
